description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/ordering-online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginSuccess" name="Login confirmation: successful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginFailure" name="Login confirmation: unsuccessful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CartComplete" name="Cart complete"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentStatus" name="Payment confirmation to customer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderAddress" name="Shipping and billing address"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Ordering">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginCredentials" name="Submit credentials"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitLogin" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" name="Successful login confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_LoginSuccess"
                      messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" name="Unsuccessful login confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="Event_LoginFailure"
                      messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CartComplete" name="Cart complete"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendCartComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCartComplete"
                      messageRef="Message_CartComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Payment data"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Start_PaymentRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentStatus" name="Payment confirmation to customer"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentStatus" targetRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderAddress" name="Shipping and billing address"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendAddress" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddress"
                      messageRef="Message_OrderAddress"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Order in online shop — customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerLogin" name="Customer logs in"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitLogin" name="Submit login credentials" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitLoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LoginFailure" name="Login unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginUnsuccessful" name="Shopping stops after unsuccessful login"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Every product selected?"
                           default="Flow_RepeatProductSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCartComplete" name="Submit completed cart" messageRef="Message_CartComplete"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" name="Proceed with payment and address"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitPaymentData" name="Enter and submit payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentConfirmed" name="Bank payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentStatus" messageRef="Message_PaymentStatus"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" name="Is billing address different?"
                           default="Flow_BillingAddressSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAddress" name="Continue with address details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAddress" name="Submit address details" messageRef="Message_OrderAddress"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrderSteps" name="Customer order steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartLogin" sourceRef="Start_CustomerLogin" targetRef="Task_SubmitLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitLoginWait" sourceRef="Task_SubmitLogin" targetRef="Gateway_WaitLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitLoginSuccess" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Event_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitLoginFailure" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Event_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccessSelect" sourceRef="Event_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailureEnd" sourceRef="Event_LoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectAdd" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddSave" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SaveCheck" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllProductsSelected" name="All selected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SendCartComplete">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepeatProductSelection" name="More products to select" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CartToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_SendCartComplete" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelAddress" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingToBillingDecision" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAddressDifferent" name="Different address" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddressDifferentFromBillingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAddressSame" name="Same address" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingToAddressMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressMergeToSend" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAddress" targetRef="Task_SendAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendAddressToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendAddress" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToJoin" sourceRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerJoinEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin" targetRef="End_CustomerOrderSteps"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" name="Credentials valid?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send successful login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginFailure" name="Send unsuccessful login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailure" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCartComplete" name="Receive completed cart" messageRef="Message_CartComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishInitialOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentData" name="Receive payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" name="Receive bank payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentStatus" name="Send payment confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddress" name="Receive address details" messageRef="Message_OrderAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalOrderJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishFinalOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginRequestCheck" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckLoginDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginValid" name="Credentials valid" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginInvalid" name="Credentials invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Task_SendLoginFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccessReceiveCart" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCartComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailureEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveCartFinishInitial" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCartComplete" targetRef="Task_FinishInitialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialFinishPreparation" sourceRef="Task_FinishInitialOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePayment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareShipment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentPreparationReceiveData" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDataSendRequest" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRequestReceiveConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveConfirmationSendStatus" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusFinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentStatus" targetRef="Gateway_FinalOrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentPreparationReceiveAddress" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressFinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddress" targetRef="Gateway_FinalOrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalJoinFinish" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalOrderJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishFinalOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishEnd" sourceRef="Task_FinishFinalOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Bank payment confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendBankConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankStartConfirm" sourceRef="Start_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankConfirmSend" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankSendEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation" targetRef="End_BankConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
